title: 共情框架：评估AI在不同社会人口群体中的对齐性
summary: 该研究通过YouGov调查（n=3011）和七个LLM，评估模型对新闻标题中情感框架（同情）的理解。发现模型与人类判断的相关性从高（0.789）到中等（0.4）不等，领先模型在人口统计子群体中总体对齐，但存在显著差异，强调差异对齐的重要性。
summary_en: This study evaluates LLMs' alignment with human emotional perception of news framing using a large UK sample and seven models. Correlations vary from high to medium, with leading models broadly aligned across demographics but significant group differences, highlighting differential alignment.
